name: drupal/ui_suite_uikit
description: A site-builder friendly UIkit theme, using the UI Suite modules: UI Patterns, UI Skins, UI Styles and UI Icons.

suggest.drupal/display_builder: Build entity displays, page layouts and views with the theme components.
suggest.drupal/ui_examples: Allows to write example pages in YML format.
suggest.drupal/webvmi: Card view modes laid out with Display Builder and the theme components.
